name: setup-php
description: Shared PHP and Composer setup for PR validation actions.

REQUIRE.description: Composer packages to install globally (`composer global require`), comma-separated, each optionally pinned to a version with `package:constraint` (e.g. `deployer/deployer:^7`). Runs on every invocation of this action within a job, regardless of whether the PHP/Composer setup itself was skipped as a duplicate - each caller may need a different global package. Packages already installed globally are skipped.

php-version.description: Detected PHP version from composer.json, or default.

php-extensions.description: Detected PHP extensions from composer.json, or empty.
